call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: $8.22B Q3 Print & $8.60B Q4 Guide — Systems Breakout (+35% QoQ)
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Tim, Systems revenue jumped nearly $1.5B sequentially to $5.73B, and you are guiding December quarter revenue up another $380M to $8.60B with 40.5% operating margins. How much of this step-function increase is Korea/Taiwan HBM and GAA versus China pull-forward?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CEO Tim Archer emphasized that China actually moderated to 35% of total revenue while Korea (20%) and Taiwan (18%) accelerated sharply as AI-driven device complexity—specifically 3D DRAM/HBM through-silicon vias and Gate-All-Around nanosheet etch—drove record tool shipments. Deferred revenue also rose $230M sequentially to $2.66B (excluding $468.3M in Japan shipments).

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: 16.9% Effective Tax Rate Impact on Q3 EPS ($2.20 vs $8.22B Revenue)
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Doug, revenue beat by over $1.2B and operating income hit $3.30B (40.2% margin), yet EPS printed at $2.20 because GAAP tax expense doubled sequentially to $559M (16.9% effective tax rate). Can you explain the tax step-up and why the stock is seeing post-market volatility?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CFO Doug Bettinger explained that the September quarter reflected a higher geographic profit mix and a discrete $11.5M tax law change item, bringing the effective tax rate to ~16.9% versus 10.9% in the June quarter—which absorbed roughly $0.16/sh of the massive operating income beat. Going forward into the December quarter, $8.60B revenue and 40.5% operating margins drive EPS up to $2.33 ± $0.15.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: $3.50B Operating Cash Flow & +27% Dividend Hike to $0.33/sh
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Your operating cash flow more than doubled sequentially from $1.46B to $3.50B, free cash flow hit $3.24B, and you repurchased $1.02B of stock while raising the dividend to $0.33. How are you thinking about capital return intensity in FY27?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Management reiterated its commitment to returning 75%-100% of free cash flow to shareholders, noting that even after $1.02B in buybacks and $325M in dividends, Lam's cash balance expanded by $1.85B in a single quarter to $7.45B.
